[//3]: # (### Coordinated Daily Activity Pattern)

The coordinated daily activity pattern model predicts the choice of daily activity pattern (DAP) for each member in the household. The DAP is categorized into three types:

- Mandatory: the person engages in at least one out-of-home mandatory activity, work, university, or school. The mandatory pattern may also include non-mandatory activities
- Non-mandatory: the person engages in only maintenance and discretionary tours, which do not contain any mandatory activities
- Home: the person does not travel outside the home

Calibration of the coordinate daily activity pattern model focused on matching the observed frequency distribution of DAP for each person type. The calibration targets were developed using BATS 2023 data. 

BATS 2023 data was underreporting tours for people under 18 due to proxy reporting so targets from the previous calibration were used for those person types. 

<Include table of BATS 2023 and previous targets>

```{python}
from calib_report import tables, figures, config
from calib_report.data import cdap

chts_file = config.CHTS_DIR / "dapSummary.csv"

chts_cdap, chts_summary = cdap.load_cdap_summary(
    chts_file, index_col="PERTYPE", columns_col="DAP", values_col="freq"
)

chts_table = cdap.format_cdap_table(chts_summary, as_share=True)
```

```{python}
bats_file = config.BATS_DIR / "dap_summaries.csv"

bats_cdap, bats_summary = cdap.load_cdap_summary(
    bats_file, index_col="person_type", columns_col="activity_pattern", values_col="num_pers"
)

bats_table = cdap.format_cdap_table(bats_summary, as_share=True)
```

```{python}
#| label: tbl-cdap-chts-share
#| tbl-cap: "Observed Daily Activity Pattern Share by Person Type (CHTS)"
tables.to_quarto(chts_table)
```

```{python}
#| label: tbl-cdap-bats-share
#| tbl-cap: "Observed Daily Activity Pattern Share by Person Type (BATS 2023)"

tables.to_quarto(bats_table)
```

```{python}
#| label: tbl-cdap-bats-share-adjusted
#| tbl-cap: "Adjusted Observed Daily Activity Pattern Share by Person Type (BATS 2023)"
adjusted_summary = cdap.blend_summaries(bats_summary, chts_summary)
adjusted_table = cdap.format_cdap_table(adjusted_summary, as_share=True)
tables.to_quarto(adjusted_table)
```
